method: Average the original 18-feature broadcast phase logistic classifier with a 22-feature classifier adding four observable, per-half availability-context features. Both use C=0.3 and identical purged training folds. The other five ensemble members, phase routing, weights and temporal rules stay unchanged.

phase_head.coverage: primary video, including missing broadcast geometry

experiments.selection: Retain the equal probability average of the original 18-feature and contextual 22-feature heads. Context-only and bagging gains at five folds failed paired mean sensitivity; their replacements were rejected. All selection reuses the same public slice.
experiments.followup_decision: Retain v11. No follow-up improves deployed five-fold macroF1 without reducing macroF1 on another audited partition. Timing-only features gain 0.000173 at five folds but lose 0.000354 at three folds; this is not an independently validated improvement.

limitations: All model and blending choices reuse the same 7500 frames and 17 public possessions; repartitions are sensitivity checks, not independent tests.
Five-fold macroF1 increases by 0.000799; six public errors are corrected and one correct frame regresses.
SpellF1 and its three missed GT possessions remain unchanged at every audited fold count.
Availability patterns depend on the recording and future context is used; transfer to unseen matches is unknown.
Private and full-match accuracy are unknown; match statistics describe predictions.
Restricted data, images, per-frame features, fitted models and prediction CSVs stay gitignored.
